title: user.role.changed
description: A user's roles in their tenant changed: the tenant's first user was created, a user was invited, an admin changed a user's roles, or a user was disabled. Each change after creation bumps the user's session version, so the identity service refuses sessions issued before it. Producer: identity. Consumers: none yet.

role.description: A role a user holds in their tenant.

roles.description: The roles the user holds after the change, sorted; empty for a disabled user, who holds none.

previous_roles.description: The roles the user held before the change, sorted; empty for a user who was just created or invited.

reason.description: Why the roles changed: the first user of a new tenant, an invitation, an admin's change, or the user being disabled.

changed_by.description: The user who made the change; null when no signed-in user made it, as when an operator set up the internal tenant.

session_version.description: The user's session version after the change; the identity service refuses access tokens that carry an older one.
